en.title: Hyper-Dimension Power Full-Stack Matrix Debuts at 2026 Hong Kong Fintech Week, Embodied AI Hard Tech Ignites the Scene
en.summary: Super Dimension Power showcased its full-stack matrix at the 2026 Hong Kong Fintech Week. The event featured an extraordinary feast of embodied artificial intelligence technology.
en.impact: Technology users and industry observers may find that these advancements highlight growing interest in embodied AI applications within the financial technology sector.
keyPoints: Super Dimension Power full-stack matrix debuted at 2026 Hong Kong Fintech Week
The exhibition featured embodied AI hard technology
Described as an extraordinary embodied artificial intelligence technology feast

keyPoints: Super Dimension Power បានបង្ហាញម៉ាទ្រីសពេញលេញក្នុង 2026 Hong Kong Fintech Week
